We got three templates. Need to pick one with reasonable similarity. Template IDs are reaction_id values? The JSON includes reaction_id. We need to use template_id in our route. Likely template_id corresponds to reaction_id. We'll pick first one: reaction_id 349569.

Now other disconnections: The sulfonamide formation: target has NS(=O)(=O) attached to aromatic ring. So we can disconnect sulfonamide to sulfonyl chloride and aniline. So forward reaction: sulfonyl chloride + amine -> sulfonamide. Broken: sulfonyl chloride (S-Cl) bond, formed S-N. Functional groups: sulfonyl chloride (maybe "sulfonyl chloride") and sulfonamide formed. Let's search.


<thought>Search for template for sulfonamide formation (sulfonyl chloride + amine → sulfonamide). Use functional_groups_broken = ["sulfonyl chloride"] and functional_groups_formed = ["sulfonamide"].</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>

  "molecule_smiles": "NS(=O)(=O)Cl",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["sulfonyl chloride"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["sulfonamide"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
